items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bill Perkins actually made a record of it [Just a Child] and I was totally aghast when he did it.

ctx.x: But they’re Lester Young solos written out for a medium sized ensemble.

Oh, well that’s probably something Perk [Bill Perkins] wanted to do. Yeah. Probably the closest to Lester Young would have been the things that the heads that Lester laid out like, “Tickle Toe,” and things like that in the early days. [sings melody] You know the whole section playing what Lester had, and it sounded like him.
So let’s see, you said you left Raeburn, you went with Jimmy Dorsey and that was a physically hard experience.
